title: Marketing Planner
subtitle: Turning a complex planning spreadsheet into a clear view teams can use.

evidence.statement: More teams can find planning information on their own
~10–20 minutes of back-and-forth removed from common information requests

quickView.problem: The planning data existed, but only teams familiar with the spreadsheet could easily use it.
quickView.evolution: The existing source of truth remains in place while the experience around it is redesigned.
quickView.product: A shared view for planning, comparison, history, and controlled editing.
quickView.impact: The merchandising team uses it daily, and more teams can find planning information on their own.
quickView.learning: Keep the system of record. Redesign how people experience it.
